summary: Independent read-only Codex reviewer examined accepted brainstorm plus three owner amendments. Seven contract refinements identified. Normalized to the workflow schema by the author; raw reviewer output is retained separately.

suggestions.title: Await scope initialization explicitly
suggestions.rationale: library.py:234 is synchronous; async sweep at :293 calls _toolkit at :300. Use an awaited once-per-scope helper, retry after cancellation.

suggestions.title: Coordinate recovery and imports with operation locks
suggestions.rationale: library.py:303-312 acts on a stale scan; age can exceed one hour for active imports. Identity at :1110-1124 needs source locking and revalidation.

suggestions.title: Check expected revision against returned read
suggestions.rationale: library.py:446-460 separates document lookup from read; toolkit.py:1082-1114 selects its own snapshot. A preliminary check alone races.

suggestions.title: Decorate only against matching generation
suggestions.rationale: toolkit.py:1349-1366 returns a bundle without its tree. agentic.py:43-51 has no stale stop reason. Fall back to stored section or omit chapter when generations differ.

suggestions.title: Handle empty filters and request-local notes
suggestions.rationale: library.py:525-534 treats empty IDs as unfiltered; multistoresearch/toolkit.py:304-331 sets successful note=None. Avoid mutable last_note.

suggestions.title: Clip and validate against the stored revision
suggestions.rationale: toolkit.py:886 clamps reads to at least 500; :910-933 returns offsets. citations.py:102 checks only substring membership; do not validate excerpt against itself.

suggestions.title: Pin gold fixtures and specify deterministic tuning
suggestions.rationale: Brainstorm:376-389 fixes runs but omits tuning policy and stale gold behavior. agentic.py:43-51 has no error stop reason; optimizer_eval.py:211-239 supplies metrics-only precedent.
